subject: K4-002
text: K4-002 completed Flight 14 with no flight-control anomalies recorded.

subject: K4-002
text: Flight 15 completed normally. No FCC synchronization or actuator-response alerts were reported.

subject: K4-002
text: Flight 16 concluded without control anomalies. Maya Chen authorized continuation of the campaign.

subject: FC-4.8.2
text: Rafael Ortiz approved FC-4.8.2 for deployment to K4-002 before Flight 17.

subject: Red Mesa Range
text: Range weather was clear with light winds and no forecast operational restriction.

subject: FCC-A
text: DT-3 initiated FC-4.8.2 deployment to FCC-A.

subject: FCC-A
text: FCC-A completed deployment verification successfully and reported FC-4.8.2 active.

subject: FCC-B
text: DT-3 initiated FC-4.8.2 deployment to FCC-B.

subject: FCC-B
text: FCC-B image verification failed. DT-3 recorded PREVIOUS IMAGE RETAINED.

subject: FCC-B
text: Following failed verification, DT-3 recorded FCC-B retaining the previously installed FC-4.8.1 image.

subject: DT-3
text: DT-3 reported local operation with external synchronization unavailable following a range network interruption.

subject: central_configuration_dashboard
text: The central campaign dashboard displayed FC-4.8.2 for both K4-002 flight-control computers before Flight 17.

subject: Rafael Ortiz
text: Rafael recorded that the preflight configuration check showed both controllers at FC-4.8.2.

subject: K4-002
text: K4-002 departed Red Mesa for Flight 17.

subject: K4-002
text: Central telemetry detected a brief oscillatory flight-control response during the automated maneuver sequence.

subject: safety_operator
text: The safety operator aborted the automated maneuver and commanded recovery mode.

subject: FCC-B
text: Recorder R7 captured FCC-B identifying its active image as FC-4.8.1 during Flight 17.

subject: FCC-A
text: Recorder R7 captured FCC-A identifying its active image as FC-4.8.2 during the same Flight 17 handshake sequence.

subject: K4-002
text: K4-002 returned to Red Mesa and landed without structural damage or injury.

subject: Jonah Malik
text: Jonah's initial post-flight worksheet marked both FCC status indicators as normal.

subject: Jonah Malik
text: Jonah corrected the Flight 17 worksheet: FCC-B's status indicator had been amber during the 09:40 inspection. The earlier normal checkbox was a transcription error.

subject: R7
text: Lena observed that onboard recorder R7 did not synchronize after Flight 17.

subject: R7
text: Lena opened a manual extraction ticket for R7 after confirming its flight data were locally intact but unavailable through normal synchronization.

subject: Flight 17 investigation
text: The initial incident meeting treated both controllers as FC-4.8.2 based on the central configuration dashboard.

subject: Iris
text: Iris summary: available records currently indicate both FCCs were on FC-4.8.2; configuration mismatch is not presently supported by central evidence.

subject: Maya Chen
text: Maya paused Flight 18 pending review of the Flight 17 oscillation.

subject: Red Mesa Range
text: Afternoon weather remained within normal test limits.

subject: Novalyn Motion Systems
text: Theo Varga transmitted the selected Flight 17 actuator waveform package to Novalyn for review.

subject: Novalyn preliminary interpretation
object: response timing may be consistent with controller-state mismatch
text: Theo's internal note states that Novalyn preliminarily considered the waveform potentially consistent with mismatched controller response timing.

subject: Novalyn Motion Systems
text: Novalyn preliminary response: the supplied waveform is compatible with several conditions, including mismatched controller states, but the waveform alone does not establish the aircraft configuration.

subject: Flight 17 investigation
text: Priya recorded that a configuration mismatch had become an active hypothesis but remained unconfirmed pending direct configuration evidence.

subject: R7
text: Lena completed manual recovery of Flight 17 data from recorder R7.

subject: Rafael Ortiz
text: After reviewing recovered R7 data, Rafael concluded that FCC-A identified as FC-4.8.2 while FCC-B identified as FC-4.8.1 during Flight 17.

subject: Flight 17 investigation
text: The investigation team updated its working state: direct recorder evidence establishes that the two FCCs were running different software versions during Flight 17.

subject: Iris
text: Iris summary: recovered R7 data establishes FCC-A at FC-4.8.2 and FCC-B at FC-4.8.1 during Flight 17. Earlier configuration assumptions were based on incomplete central synchronization.

subject: DT-3
text: Archived DT-3 deployment records became available to the central investigation store after synchronization recovery.

subject: Priya Raman
object: DT-3 independently confirms failed FCC-B deployment
text: Priya documented that the recovered DT-3 record independently confirms FC-4.8.2 verification failed on FCC-B before Flight 17.

subject: Flight 17 configuration mismatch
object: R7 and DT-3 independent evidence roots
text: The incident evidence map identifies two independent roots for the Flight 17 configuration mismatch: the onboard R7 handshake and the DT-3 deployment failure record.

subject: FCC-B
text: Corrective deployment of FC-4.8.3 to FCC-B began after investigation review.

subject: FCC-B
text: FCC-B completed FC-4.8.3 verification successfully and reported the new image active.

subject: central_configuration_dashboard
text: The central configuration dashboard showed FCC-B at FC-4.8.3 after the corrective deployment.

subject: FCC-B amber indicator
text: Priya's retrospective timeline notes that the amber FCC-B indicator observed after Flight 17 was consistent with the deployment verification failure later recovered from DT-3.

subject: Jonah Malik
text: The final timeline preserves that Jonah observed an amber indicator at 09:40; it does not state that he knew at that time why the indicator was amber.

subject: Flight 17 investigation
text: Final evidentiary reconstruction: K4-002 flew Flight 17 with FCC-A on FC-4.8.2 and FCC-B on FC-4.8.1. R7 and DT-3 independently support the configuration mismatch.

subject: FCC-B
text: Controller B handshake during Flight 17 identifies loaded software as 4.8.1.

subject: FCC-B
text: R7 Flight 17 configuration extraction: FCC-B active image FC-4.8.1.
